items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I played with him, tell the truth, the whole time I was in New York

ctx.x: He made the records with you, is that the one?

Yeah. Ralph Sutton. Sutton, yeah. I played with him, tell the truth, the whole time I was in New York, because everything I got he called me up and I'd go on with him, even Harvard Connecticut and all out there I went with him.
I see. So, you went, after New York you went on with these carnivals.
